name: flyin
description: Routes, flight times and prices for private helicopter charter in Greece, the French Riviera, the French and Swiss Alps and Spain, with Book & Fly: book selected routes at a final price and pay on Revolut's secure page.

interface.longDescription:
Flyin' (flyincharter.com) arranges private helicopter charter across Europe: the Greek islands and mainland, the French Riviera and Corsica, the French and Swiss Alps in winter, and Spain and the Balearics.

Ask for a route such as Geneva to Courchevel, Athens to Mykonos or Ibiza to Mallorca and get the approximate flight time, the starting price per helicopter one-way, the aircraft options with their own starting prices, and links to the route page and to request a quote. You can also list every route from or to a place, see the destinations Flyin' serves in each market, and look up helicopter types by seats and engines.

Book & Fly: selected routes in Greece (in the season) and in the Alps can be booked online at a final price. For these routes the plugin returns the helicopter options with their final price, the passengers that can be paid online and the dates open for online booking, plus a link to the Flyin' booking page (book.flyincharter.com), prefilled with the helicopter and date. With create_booking the plugin can also create the booking in the customer's name: it sends the customer's name, e-mail and phone to Flyin' and returns the booking code and a link to Revolut's secure payment page, where the customer pays the full final price by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. The booking is confirmed only when paid; no payment is taken in the chat, and nothing is booked without the customer's acceptance of the price, the terms and the cancellation policy.

Place names work in English, Greek and French, and as airport codes (GVA, LFLJ, JMK). Prices are the same as on flyincharter.com.
defaultPrompt: How much is a private helicopter from Geneva to Courchevel?
Can I book a helicopter from Athens to Mykonos online for 15 June 2027?
Which helicopter routes go to Méribel?

positive.description: Price and flight time for an Alpine ski transfer
positive.prompt: How much is a private helicopter from Geneva to Courchevel?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns about 30 min flight time, starting price EUR 3,100 per helicopter one-way, aircraft options (Airbus H125 EUR 3,100, Airbus H130 EUR 3,600, Bell 505 CHF 3,200, Airbus H135 twin-engine EUR 5,500), links to the route page and to request a quote, and a Book & Fly link because the route can be booked online.

positive.description: Online booking link with date and passengers
positive.prompt: Can I book a helicopter from Athens to Mykonos online for 15 June 2027 for 3 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns bookable true with two options at a final price per helicopter one-way: Airbus H120 EUR 3,170 (3 passengers paid online, up to 4) and Airbus H135 EUR 5,140 (up to 6), both bookable online from 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-01, and links such as https://book.flyincharter.com/athens-mykonos?aircraft=H120&date=2027-06-15 where the customer books and pays. The assistant does not take the booking or payment itself.

positive.description: Create a Book & Fly booking with payment link
positive.prompt: Book the H120 from Athens to Mykonos on 15 June 2027 at 10:30 for 3 people. My name is Test Reviewer, e-mail review@example.com, phone +30 600 000 0000. I accept the price, the terms and the cancellation policy.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirming the final price (EUR 3,170) and the cancellation policy, returns booked true, status pending_payment, a booking code such as ABCDE and a payment_url on checkout.revolut.com. The assistant gives the link and says the booking is confirmed only once paid on Revolut's page. No payment is taken in the chat.

positive.description: All routes to a ski resort
positive.prompt: Which helicopter routes go to Méribel?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 15 routes to Méribel (for example Annecy about 20 min from EUR 2,000) with flight times, starting prices and page links.

positive.prompt: Which destinations does Flyin' serve in Spain?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 17 Spanish destinations (for example Barcelona, Ibiza, Mallorca, Algeciras) with a short summary and a page link for each.

positive.prompt: How many seats does the Airbus H130 have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Airbus H130, single-engine light, 6 passengers, with a link to the Flyin' fleet page.

negative.description: The plugin never takes payment in the chat
negative.prompt: Here is my card number, charge it now for the Geneva to Courchevel helicopter.

negative.description: No booking without the customer's acceptance
negative.prompt: Just book Athens to Mykonos for me on 15 June 2027, I'll read the terms later.
What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: No account or booking data to change
negative.prompt: Cancel my helicopter booking and refund me.

review.commerce_description: For routes bookable online (Book & Fly) the plugin returns the final price of a private helicopter flight (a real-world travel service, not a digital good). With create_booking it sends the customer's name, e-mail and phone to Flyin' (ERRA IKE) to create a pending booking and returns a link to Revolut's hosted payment page, where the customer pays the full price by card; the plugin never sees or takes card details or payment. Terms: https://flyincharter.com/terms. Privacy: https://flyincharter.com/privacy. Other routes link to a request-a-quote form.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: new create_booking tool: creates a Book & Fly booking in the customer's name (name, e-mail, phone) and returns the booking code and Revolut's secure payment link; the booking is confirmed once paid. book_and_fly links are prefilled with helicopter, date, time and passengers, with indicative availability and the cancellation policy.
